# GetEntityBrush <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Brushes](Blitz3D-Brushes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetEntityBrush:Int32 entity:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | The entity. |

**Returns:** A brush handle.

## Description

Makes a new brush that has the same look as an entity: its color, alpha, shininess, blend mode, effects and textures. Free the brush with [FreeBrush](FreeBrush) when you no longer need it.
